What you get in the founding cohort

  • The full 7-Day Sprint with a tutor who speaks Spanish.
  • Two 45-minute calls, on Day 1 and Day 7.
  • Daily feedback on your voice notes.
  • Your Day 1 and Day 7 talks recorded, so you can hear the difference.

Questions people ask

Who can join the founding cohort?

Adults whose first language is Spanish and who want to speak English with more confidence. There are ten places.

What does it cost?

Nothing. The founding cohort is free. In return, we ask for honest feedback on the programme.

Will I be recorded?

Your Day 1 and Day 7 talks are recorded so you can hear your progress. We ask separately, in writing, before using any clip publicly, and you can say no.

What happens after I send my request?

The tutor contacts you to arrange your Day 1 call.
